visual_elements.description: Scatter plot in left top panel: vertical axis labeled x2, horizontal axis labeled x1 (no numeric ticks). Cluster of red filled circles on the left side, cluster of blue filled squares on the right side. A straight diagonal solid line labeled 'Linear boundary' separates the two clusters cleanly.

Two scatter plots in right top panel under 'Not linearly separable'. Left plot: axes x2 (vertical) and x1 (horizontal); red circles and blue squares intermixed such that a straight solid line cannot separate them; a dashed curved line labeled 'Nonlinear boundary' arcs around a group of red points; a dashed ellipse encircles a central mixed cluster. Right plot: axes x2 and x1; red circles clustered in the middle surrounded by blue squares at the corners/edges; a dashed circle drawn around the central red cluster; a solid straight line fails to separate the classes.

Large square scatter plot at bottom: both axes numeric with ticks approximately from -2.5 to 2.5 (visible tick labels include -2.5, -2, -1.5, -1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5 [?]). Many small dots in three colors (red, green, blue) scattered across the plane, with a loose curved/swirled structure; a small gray tooltip-style label reading 'Data fitting [?]' near the center around (0.5, 0).

recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#E8E8E8) and draw a thin dark-red (#A02040) rectangle border inset slightly from all edges. 2. Add a yellow circle (#FFFF66) with black bold text '35' at the top-right corner. 3. Draw a large white rectangle with thin black border across the upper half; split it into two equal panels. 4. Left panel: bold heading 'Linearly separable', below it smaller text 'A linear decision boundary that separates the two classes exists'; draw a small axes plot with vertical axis 'x2' and horizontal 'x1'; place ~8 red filled circles on the left and ~8 blue filled squares on the right; draw a solid diagonal line between them labeled 'Linear boundary'. 5. Right panel: bold heading 'Not linearly separable', subtitle 'No linear decision boundary that separates the two classes perfectly exists'; create two small scatter plots side by side, each with x2/x1 axes, red circles and blue squares intermixed; on the first, add a dashed curved arc labeled 'Nonlinear boundary' and a dashed ellipse around a central cluster plus a solid straight line that fails to separate; on the second, place red circles in the center with blue squares around them, a dashed circle around the reds, and a solid line that fails to separate. 6. Bottom center-left: draw a square white plot with thin red border; add numeric axes from -2.5 to 2.5 on both x and y; scatter many small dots in red, green, and blue in a loose curved pattern; add a small gray label 'Data fitting' near the center. 7. Use sans-serif font throughout; headings bold, subtitles smaller gray.
